method.bootstrap: circular session-block bootstrap (house convention: src/analytics/primary_objective.py::_idx_moving_block / make_indices('moving5')), block=5 trading sessions, B=10000, seed=20260808, applied PAIRED (same resampled index draw used for candidate and full every replicate, not independent marginal bootstraps)

method.cdar_definition: mean of worst 5% of the EOD dollar drawdown series (alpha=0.95) -- primary_objective.cdar_dollar, house convention

data_availability_caveats: This agent was supplied daily-aggregate (session-level) P&L CSVs only for B0/B1/B_FULL (mapped internally to Q/Z/M via construction-description + exact point-metric match to the supplied anonymized blob; the mapping is not reported in the label-facing output beyond what was needed to run the test).

Bar-level intraday P&L, per-cost-tick-level re-simulated daily P&L, and trade-level P&L were NOT supplied. Margins requiring those (intraday_dd_margin, cost_stress_margin, the trade-leg of top_day_and_trade_retention_margin) are sourced from the supplied anonymized metrics blob and flagged as such rather than independently recomputed by this agent.

All margins that CAN be computed from daily-aggregate P&L (sharpe_margin, cdar_margin, annual_partition_margin, day-leg of top10 retention, concentration_gate, after_cost_positive_margin) were independently computed by this agent from the raw daily CSVs and cross-checked against the supplied blob figures -- all cross-checks matched exactly.

power_caveat_realized.note: Frozen margin spec flagged that paired-bootstrap power depends on candidate/full daily P&L correlation (rho), unmeasured until the bootstrap actually ran. Realized rho:
power_caveat_realized.interpretation: Z_vs_M realized a high correlation (~0.985, in the 'near-neighbor' regime the spec anticipated) yet still landed just under the 90% pass bar (p_hat=0.8473) -> genuinely INCONCLUSIVE, consistent with the disclosed power caveat rather than a clean failure. Q_vs_M realized a much lower correlation (~0.814, the 'far rung' regime) AND a large point-estimate Sharpe gap (-0.57, far outside the +/-0.10 margin) -> the low p_hat (0.058) reflects a real gap, not merely low power.
